whyItMatters: Detects modification of EC2 compute configuration (ModifyImageAttribute, ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions, ModifyLaunchTemplate, ModifyInstanceAttribute) excluding startup-script (userData) changes which are covered separately, plus service-quota increase requests. Adversaries alter configurations to weaken security (e.g. disabling IMDSv2), share images, or raise quotas to launch more compute (e.g. for cryptomining). Aligned to MITRE ATT&CK DET0392-adjacent T1578.005 analytic AN1356 (RequestServiceQuotaIncrease).
